results.name: Dennis Posed 004 - Male Standing Business Model
results.description:
Posed People are static 3D People. Each of them portrays a specific natural pose that has been captured in our state-of-the-art 3D scanner. The geometry and high-resolution textures of all Posed 3D People have been manually refined to match the vividness and authenticity of real human beings. Posed People include pre-built materials and are ready to render.

✔ Two versions: 100k & 30k polycount ✔ Unwrapped UVs ✔ 8k high-resolution textures ✔ includes Diffuse and Normal maps ✔ includes Alpha maps

Renderpeople offers a diverse portfolio of lifelike and easy-to-use for renderings. Download and test our free 3D People to convince yourself of the great quality and usability of our Renderpeople products.

Find more than 3500 different on: https://renppl.co/3D-People-Catalog

results.name: Female Worker Standing Pose
results.description:
Female Worker Standing Pose,
In the bustling environment of a construction site, a female worker strides confidently along a makeshift catwalk. She is dressed in practical workwear, including sturdy boots, durable pants, and a high-visibility vest. Her helmet, a symbol of safety and professionalism, sits securely on her head. The sun casts a warm glow on the scene, highlighting the determination in her eyes as she navigates the site with purpose and precision.
